spells.name: Eldritch Blast
spells.description: You hurl a beam of crackling magical energy at a creature within range. Make a ranged spell attack. On a hit, the target takes 1d10 force damage. The spell creates additional beams as your character level increases.
spells.upcastEffect: The spell creates additional beams at character levels 5, 11, and 17. Each beam requires a separate attack roll.

spells.name: Fire Bolt
spells.description: You hurl a mote of fire at a creature or object within range. Make a ranged spell attack. On a hit, the target takes 1d10 fire damage. A flammable unattended object hit by the spell ignites.
spells.upcastEffect: Damage increases to 2d10 at character level 5, 3d10 at level 11, and 4d10 at level 17.

spells.name: Mage Hand
spells.description: A spectral hand appears at a point within range. It can manipulate objects, open unlocked doors or containers, retrieve items, or pour contents from a vessel. It cannot attack, activate magic items, or carry more than 10 pounds.
spells.upcastEffect: No additional effect.

spells.name: Prestidigitation
spells.description: You create a minor magical effect. You can create a harmless sensory effect, light or snuff a small flame, clean or soil an object, chill or warm a small amount of material, create a small mark, or produce a minor trinket or illusion.
spells.upcastEffect: You can have up to three non-instantaneous effects active at once.

spells.name: Guidance
spells.description: You touch a willing creature and offer divine guidance. Once before the spell ends, the creature can roll a d4 and add the result to one ability check of its choice.
spells.upcastEffect: No additional effect.

spells.name: Sacred Flame
spells.description: Radiant flame descends upon a creature you can see within range. The target must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or take 1d8 radiant damage. The target gains no benefit from Half Cover or Three-Quarters Cover against this saving throw.
spells.upcastEffect: Damage increases to 2d8 at character level 5, 3d8 at level 11, and 4d8 at level 17.

spells.name: Minor Illusion
spells.description: You create a sound or an image of an object within range. The sound can range from a whisper to a scream. The image must fit within a 5-foot Cube and cannot create sound, light, smell, or other sensory effects. Physical interaction reveals the image as an illusion.
spells.upcastEffect: No additional effect.

spells.name: Light
spells.description: You touch one object that is no larger than 10 feet in any dimension. The object sheds Bright Light in a 20-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 20 feet. Covering the object blocks the light.
spells.upcastEffect: No additional effect.

spells.name: Vicious Mockery
spells.description: You unleash a string of magically empowered insults at a creature that can hear you. The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or take 1d6 psychic damage and have Disadvantage on its next attack roll before the end of its next turn.
spells.upcastEffect: Damage increases to 2d6 at character level 5, 3d6 at level 11, and 4d6 at level 17.

spells.name: Ray of Frost
spells.description: A frigid beam of blue-white energy streaks toward a creature within range. Make a ranged spell attack. On a hit, the target takes 1d8 cold damage and its Speed is reduced by 10 feet until the start of your next turn.
spells.upcastEffect: Damage increases to 2d8 at character level 5, 3d8 at level 11, and 4d8 at level 17.

spells.name: Shocking Grasp
spells.description: Lightning springs from your hand to deliver a shock to a creature you touch. Make a melee spell attack. On a hit, the target takes 1d8 lightning damage and cannot take Reactions until the start of its next turn. You have Advantage on the attack roll if the target is wearing metal armor.
spells.upcastEffect: Damage increases to 2d8 at character level 5, 3d8 at level 11, and 4d8 at level 17.

spells.name: Message
spells.description: You point toward a creature within range and whisper a message. Only the target hears it, and it can reply in a whisper that only you can hear. The spell can travel around obstacles if you know the target and the message can travel through an opening.
spells.upcastEffect: No additional effect.

spells.name: Thaumaturgy
spells.description: You manifest a minor divine wonder. You can amplify your voice, cause flames to flicker or change color, create harmless tremors, make an unlocked door swing open or shut, or alter the appearance of your eyes.
spells.upcastEffect: You can have up to three non-instantaneous effects active at once.

spells.name: Druidcraft
spells.description: You create a minor natural wonder. You can predict local weather, cause a flower to bloom or a seed to sprout, create a harmless sensory effect, or briefly light or snuff a small flame.
spells.upcastEffect: No additional effect.

spells.name: Produce Flame
spells.description: A flickering flame appears in your hand. It sheds Bright Light in a 10-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 10 feet. You can also hurl the flame at a creature within 30 feet as a ranged spell attack, dealing 1d8 fire damage on a hit.
spells.upcastEffect: Damage increases to 2d8 at character level 5, 3d8 at level 11, and 4d8 at level 17.

spells.name: Spare the Dying
spells.description: You touch a living creature with 0 Hit Points. The creature becomes Stable and no longer needs to make Death Saving Throws.
spells.upcastEffect: No additional effect.

spells.name: Resistance
spells.description: You touch a willing creature and grant it magical protection. Once before the spell ends, the creature can roll a d4 and add the result to one saving throw of its choice.
spells.upcastEffect: No additional effect.

spells.name: Mending
spells.description: This spell repairs a single break or tear in an object you touch, such as a broken chain link, a torn cloak, or a cracked key. The repair leaves no trace of the former damage.
spells.upcastEffect: No additional effect.

spells.name: Toll the Dead
spells.description: You point at one creature within range, and the sound of a mournful bell fills the air around it. The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or take 1d8 necrotic damage. If the target is missing any Hit Points, it instead takes 1d12 necrotic damage.
spells.upcastEffect: Damage increases to 2d8 or 2d12 at character level 5, 3d8 or 3d12 at level 11, and 4d8 or 4d12 at level 17.

spells.name: Chill Touch
spells.description: You create a skeletal hand that reaches toward a creature within range. Make a ranged spell attack. On a hit, the target takes 1d10 necrotic damage and cannot regain Hit Points until the start of your next turn.
spells.upcastEffect: Damage increases to 2d10 at character level 5, 3d10 at level 11, and 4d10 at level 17.

spells.name: True Strike
spells.description: Guided by a flash of magical insight, you make one attack with the weapon used in the spell's casting. You can use your spellcasting ability instead of Strength or Dexterity for the attack and damage rolls. The attack deals Radiant damage or the weapon's normal damage type.
spells.upcastEffect: The attack's extra Radiant damage increases at character levels 5, 11, and 17.

spells.name: Cure Wounds
spells.description: A creature you touch regains Hit Points equal to 2d8 plus your spellcasting ability modifier.
spells.upcastEffect: Healing increases by 2d8 for each spell level above 1.

spells.name: Healing Word
spells.description: A creature of your choice that you can see within range regains Hit Points equal to 2d4 plus your spellcasting ability modifier.
spells.upcastEffect: Healing increases by 2d4 for each spell level above 1.

spells.name: Shield
spells.castingTime: 1 Reaction, taken when hit by an attack or targeted by Magic Missile
spells.description: A magical barrier protects you. Until the start of your next turn, you gain a +5 bonus to AC, including against the triggering attack, and take no damage from Magic Missile.
spells.upcastEffect: No additional effect.

spells.name: Magic Missile
spells.description: You create three glowing darts of magical force. Each dart strikes a creature of your choice that you can see within range, dealing 1d4 + 1 force damage. The darts strike simultaneously.
spells.upcastEffect: You create one additional dart for each spell level above 1.

spells.name: Detect Magic
spells.description: For the duration, you sense the presence of magic within 30 feet. If you sense magic, you can use an action to see a faint aura around any visible creature or object bearing magic and learn its school of magic, if any.
spells.upcastEffect: No additional effect.

spells.name: Bless
spells.description: You bless up to three creatures within range. Whenever a target makes an attack roll or saving throw before the spell ends, it can roll a d4 and add the number rolled to the attack roll or saving throw.
spells.upcastEffect: You can target one additional creature for each spell level above 1.

spells.name: Guiding Bolt
spells.description: A flash of light streaks toward a creature within range. Make a ranged spell attack. On a hit, the target takes 4d6 Radiant damage, and the next attack roll made against the target before the end of your next turn has Advantage.
spells.upcastEffect: Damage increases by 1d6 for each spell level above 1.

spells.name: Misty Step
spells.description: Briefly surrounded by silvery mist, you teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see.
spells.upcastEffect: No additional effect.

spells.name: Counterspell
spells.castingTime: 1 Reaction, taken when you see a creature within range casting a spell
spells.description: You attempt to interrupt a creature in the process of casting a spell. The creature makes a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the spell fails and has no effect.
spells.upcastEffect: If you cast this spell using a spell slot of level 4 or higher, the interrupted spell automatically fails if its level is less than the level of the spell slot used.

spells.name: Fireball
spells.description: A bright streak flashes from your pointing finger to a point you choose within range, then blossoms with a low roar into an explosion of flame. Each creature in a 20-foot-radius Sphere centered on that point makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking 8d6 fire damage on a failed save or half as much on a success.
spells.upcastEffect: Damage increases by 1d6 for each spell level above 3.
